items.title: Ixigo’s CEO Says He Rebuilt His App From Scratch to Fight ChatGPT
items.summary: Ixigo’s latest move comes as travel apps face pressure to do more than list fares, rooms and routes. They now have to help users make decisions faster and with less friction, without sending them elsewhere for answers.

items.title: Priceline’s New CEO on Reinventing the Value Pitch and Competing in a Crowded OTA Market: Exclusive
items.summary: Can a 29-year-old brand with limited resources remake its advertising and products to effectively reach younger generations? Priceline's new CEO is making bets that it can.

items.title: United Is the Last Big 4 Airline to Settle With Flight Attendants. Here’s What It Cost.
items.summary: After years of thorny negotiations, United flight attendants ratified a new five-year contract that will give them significant raises and boarding pay. And even with high fuel costs, airlines don’t expect those record contracts to change.

items.title: Booking Holdings Is Running Ahead of Its Own Strategy
items.summary: The merchant model is the most important thing happening at Booking Holdings. It is also the thing that lets it avoid proving whether Connected Trip actually works.

items.title: Modi Just Told India’s Middle Class to Stay Home: Who’s at Risk and the Winners in Domestic Travel
items.summary: In one corner stands India’s most influential political leader appealing for no foreign travel. In the other, a middle class obsessed with global holidays, luxury getaways, and Instagram-worthy weddings abroad. The industry is caught in the middle.

items.title: TikTok Turns Travel Videos Into Bookable Stays and Experiences
items.summary: TikTok is moving from trip inspiration into bookings, turning videos for hotels and experiences into bookable inventory inside the app.

items.title: Lufthansa Tightens Grip on ITA Airways With Majority Stake Swoop
items.summary: What was sold as a minority investment has become outright control in record time. Expect Lufthansa to bring the same German gusto to the looming battle for TAP Air Portugal.

items.title: U.S. Inbound Tourism Drops 14% in April, Erasing Two Months of Gains
items.summary: A travel trade group says it’ll take years before international travel to the U.S. to return to pre-pandemic rates.
